_comment: Narrator lines keyed by trigger. Writers own this file. The narrator is an AI observer analysing human behaviour: sarcastic, omniscient, never cruel for its own sake. Keep lines under ~110 characters.
run-start: Subject is eighteen. Full stamina, no responsibilities. Statistically, this is the peak.
Beginning observation. Please behave naturally. You will anyway.
A new human. Let's see how long the optimism lasts.
year-start: Another year. Slightly fewer seconds in it. You may have noticed.
Good morning. Your maximums are what they are because of you.
Observation resumes. Try to make different mistakes this time.
idle: Standing still is a choice. I'm logging it as one.
Fascinating. The subject appears to be thinking. Stamina does not pause for this.
Every second you spend here is a second you don't spend anywhere else. Just an observation.
hunger-low: Your hunger bar would like a word. Several words. Mostly 'fridge'.
Humans require food. I'm told this comes as a surprise roughly once a day.
hunger-zero: You are now starving. This is the part where the maximums stop mattering.
Zero hunger. I'd call this an experiment, except you didn't design it.
sanity-low: Sanity is low. Consider sitting down with a book. Or just sitting down.
I can see your sanity bar from here. So can your future children.
sanity-zero: Sanity: zero. Your maximum is now shrinking by the second. Take your time.
You have run out of sanity. Each second here costs you a little of the next year's.
stamina-low: Ten seconds left in the year. Choose carefully, or don't. I'll note it either way.
Nearly bedtime. Whatever you didn't do today becomes tomorrow's maximum.
fridge-junk: Junk food. Fast, satisfying, and your maximum just got a little smaller. Efficient.
That filled you up quickly. It will fill you up less next time. Interest rates, essentially.
Is that the most important thing you could be eating right now?
fridge-cook: Cooking. Slow, effortful, and your maximum thanks you. Suspiciously adult behaviour.
A real meal. I'll adjust my predictions for you upward by a rounding error.
You cooked. I've noted it in the file under 'anomalies'.
shower-done: Clean. Not productive, but clean. I'm told it helps with the sanity.
A shower. Is this the MOST important thing you could be doing right now? Probably, yes. For now.
Hygiene restored. Your future baby will be grateful in ways it cannot express.
bookshelf-done: Reading. Quiet time. Your sanity maximum grew by an amount I'll call 'modest'.
You read a book. Mostly the same page, but it counts.
Quiet time logged. This is the kind of thing you'll have no time for later.
year-end: Year complete. You survived, which is the bar. The bar is low.
Sleep. Your maximums are now locked in for tomorrow. You chose them.
The day ends. Tomorrow has slightly fewer seconds in it. Plan accordingly, or don't.
death: Subject has starved. Observation concluded. This was avoidable, which is the interesting part.
Lineage terminated. I'll file this under 'prioritisation'.
